bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar Cabinet approves draft Green Hydrogen Policy 2026; targets 1 lakh tonnes annual ...
bihar_raw_news.content: Home All News Green Hydrogen Bihar Cabinet approves draft Green Hydrogen Policy 2026; targets 1 lakh tonnes... All News Green Hydrogen Bihar Cabinet approves draft Green Hydrogen Policy 2026; targets 1 lakh tonnes annual production by 2031 By BioEnergyTimes October 1, 2026 Patna: The Bihar Cabinet on Wednesday approved the draft Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy, 2026 , aimed at promoting renewable energy, reducing carbon emissions and lowering dependence on imported natural gas, The Hindu reported. The policy seeks to attract private investment in the green hydrogen sector and create employment opportunities in the state, Cabinet Secretariat Department Additional Chief Secretary Arvind Kumar Chaudhary said during a post-Cabinet briefing. The policy is aligned with the Centre’s National Green Hydrogen Mission, launched in 2023. Chaudhary said the policy will promote green hydrogen production and consumption, market development, electrolyser manufacturing and other components across the value chain. The state has set a target of producing 0.1 million metric tonnes (1 lakh tonnes) of green hydrogen annually by 2031 . The policy also envisages establishing 1 GW of electrolyser manufacturing capacity and developing around 2.5 GW of renewable energy capacity through green hydrogen and its derivative projects. The Bihar government expects the policy to attract investments of around Rs 16,000 crore and generate approximately 12,000 direct and indirect jobs . The Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA) has been designated as the nodal agency for implementing the policy. According to Chaudhary, the policy is primarily aimed at decarbonisation and supporting the long-term goal of achieving net-zero emissions. VAT on ATF reduced at RCS airports The Cabinet also approved reducing the VAT rate on Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) from 1% to zero at airports covered under the Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS). The state had earlier reduced the VAT on ATF used as aircraft fuel from 29% to a uniform 4% in June 2025. The latest decision is expected to support an increase in regional air connectivity and contribute to economic activity in the state. Posts approved for universities The Cabinet approved the creation of 34 posts of officers and employees for the administrative functioning of Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science University in Bhagalpur. A similar 34 posts were approved for Shaheed Jubba Sahni University of Architecture and Civil Engineering in Muzaffarpur. The Cabinet also approved the contractual engagement of 35 personnel across various categories for the Buddha Samyak Darshan Museum-cum-Memorial Stupa in Vaishali, as well as the Directorate of Museums and government museums. The appointments will be for 11 months or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier. Hemophilia scheme approved The Cabinet approved implementation of the Mukhya Mantri Hemophilia Yojana under the Mukhya Mantri Chikitsa Sahayta Kosh to improve treatment facilities for hemophilia patients in Bihar. The government said there are 255 hemophilia patients in the state. The scheme will provide Emicizumab, a medicine used in the treatment of hemophilia. Water cannons and Vajra vehicles The Cabinet also approved the procurement of 30 water cannons at Rs 88 lakh

bihar_raw_news.title: CM Samrat Choudhary Seeks IAF Assistance for Flood Relief and Rescue Operations - Newsonair
bihar_raw_news.content: News On AIR | October 1, 2026 7:45 PM Bihar Floods: CM Samrat Choudhary Seeks IAF Assistance for Flood Relief and Rescue Operations Bihar continues to battle floods. Several rivers in the state are flowing above the danger mark. Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has sought the assistance of the Indian Air Force for relief and rescue operations, in view of the seriousness of the situation. After inspecting the rising water level of the Ganga in Patna today, Mr. Choudhary told reporters that several rivers in the state are flowing at high levels. He said the next forty-eight hours will be extremely crucial for Bihar. Amid the rising water level of the Gandak, breaches in embankments at several places have led to the rapid spread of floodwater in low-lying areas. Saran, Gopalganj, East Champaran, West Champaran and Vaishali are among the worst-affected districts. The rising water levels of the Bagmati and Kosi have also inundated several villages in Darbhanga, Samastipur, Supaul and Saharsa districts.

bihar_raw_news.title: Ceigall India shareholders reject Section 185 loan resolution at AGM - ScanX
bihar_raw_news.content: ScanX News Ceigall India appoints five directors, rejects Section 185 loan resolution Ceigall India appoints five directors, rejects Section 185 loan resolution 2 min read | Published on 01 Oct 2026, 07:15 PM | Updated on 01 Oct 2026, 07:33 PM Reviewed by Ashish T ScanX News Team Add as a preferred source on Google Key Highlights Five directors appointed or re-appointed, including Vishal Anand and Dr. Pawan Kumar Section 185 loan resolution rejected by shareholders with 28% institutional opposition FY26 audited financials and final dividend approved at 24th AGM Institutional investors supported material related-party transactions but opposed new loans powered by *this image is generated using AI for illustrative purposes only. Ceigall India Limited shareholders approved the appointment and re-appointment of five directors at their 24th Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, while rejecting a special resolution on related-party loans. The meeting saw the passage of 21 out of 22 agenda items. Key approvals included the adoption of audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY26, declaration of a final dividend, and various director appointments. However, the resolution seeking approval to advance loans or provide security to related parties under Section 185 of the Companies Act, 2013, failed to secure the necessary majority. Director Appointments and Re-appointments The company disclosed the outcome of the management changes via a filing to BSE and NSE on October 1, 2026. The following appointments were ratified by shareholders: Vishal Anand was re-appointed as Non-Executive Independent Director for a second term of five years, commencing October 26, 2026. Gurpreet Kaur was re-appointed as Non-Executive Independent Director for a second term of five years. Ankit Kumar Agarwal was appointed as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a first term of five years, effective July 1, 2026. He is the Co-founder and CEO of InsuranceDekho. Ayyalusamy Saravanan was appointed as Whole-Time Director for two years, effective July 1, 2026. He brings nearly 33 years of experience in the infrastructure sector. Dr. Pawan Kumar was appointed as Whole-Time Director. He holds a Ph.D. from IIT Roorkee and has over 33 years of experience in infrastructure and construction. All appointed directors are not related to any other directors or key managerial personnel of the company and are not debarred from holding office by SEBI or other authorities. Rejection of Related-Party Loan Approval Resolution No. 10, which sought approval for advancing loans, giving guarantees, or providing security to persons specified under Section 185, failed to pass. Promoters and promoter group abstained from voting due to their interest in the transaction. Among public shareholders, institutional investors voted against the resolution with 28.00% of their polled votes opposing it. Non-institutional public shareholders showed stronger support with only 3.10% voting against. Despite this, the overall weighted vote resulted in the failure of the special resolution. Approval of Material Related Party Transactions Shareholders approved material related party transactions with multiple subsidiaries and affiliates, including Ceigall Ambala Chandigarh Zirakpur Limited, Ceigall Ayodhya Bypass Private Limited, Ceigall Green Energy MH1 Limited, and Velgaon Power

bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar to Launch Sankalp Portal for Digital Monitoring of Government Work - Drishti IAS
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar Prev Next Bihar to Launch Sankalp Portal for Digital Monitoring of Government Work 01 Oct 2026 2 min read Why in News? The Bihar Government is developing the Sankalp Portal to bring information on the 100-day report card, departmental progress, Chief Minister’s announcements, Cabinet decisions and development projects under a unified digital monitoring system. Key Points Sankalp Portal: The Bihar Government is developing the Sankalp Portal to provide a consolidated digital platform for monitoring government programmes, decisions, announcements and implementation progress. 100-Day Report Card: The portal will track progress against work undertaken during the government’s initial 100-day period . Development Schemes: Bihar had earlier highlighted 2,476 development schemes worth ₹11,464 crore that were inaugurated or had their foundation stones laid during the 100-day period. The portal has been structured around 10 windows covering different areas of government monitoring, including the 100-day report card, Bihar Gati projects, flagship greenfield projects, CM announcements and Cabinet decisions . Infrastructure Projects: A dedicated section will monitor infrastructure projects worth more than ₹30 crore , enabling officials to track their progress and implementation. Sahyog Programme: The portal will include information on applications received under the Sahyog programme and the action taken on them. Digital Monitoring: The initiative is part of Bihar’s broader shift towards online monitoring of government work and compliance , reducing dependence on traditional hard-copy records. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar launches 'Ganna Saathi' AI chatbot, digital ID for sugarcane farmers - ChiniMandi
bihar_raw_news.content: All News English Indian Sugar News Sugar News AI Representational Image Patna: The Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department has launched a digital initiative to provide sugarcane farmers direct access to departmental schemes, services and application-related information, Bhaskar reported. Sugarcane Industries Minister Sanjay Kumar on Wednesday launched the ‘Ganna Saathi’ AI chatbot and ‘Ganna Kisan Pehchan Patra’ (Sugarcane Farmer Identity Card). The identity card will serve as a unique digital identity for each sugarcane farmer. A QR code on the card can be scanned using a mobile phone to access information on departmental programmes, schemes and the status of applications. Developed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Bihar, the ‘Ganna Saathi’ AI chatbot will provide government services to farmers and citizens through a conversational interface. The chatbot is designed to guide farmers step-by-step instead of requiring them to navigate through multiple menus on the department’s portal. Farmers can select options or enter limited information to access the required service. The department said the digital system would facilitate faster exchange of information between sugarcane farmers and officials. Application and permit status Kumar said farmers would be able to check the status of their applications, permits and claims through the ‘Ganna Saathi’ chatbot. The system can retain information such as the farmer’s Ganna ID or application number during a conversation, eliminating the need to enter the same details repeatedly. The chatbot can also understand the context of a conversation and respond to follow-up queries. The department said information related to the conversation is deleted after the session ends. Hindi and English support The digital service is available in both Hindi and English. It also includes a text-to-speech or ‘read aloud’ facility, allowing users to listen to the chatbot’s responses. Farmers can use the conversational service to obtain information about scheme eligibility, application procedures and required documents. Meanwhile, Sugarcane Industries Department Secretary Dharmendra Singh said applications have been invited from investors interested in the limited prime land available in the state under the Sugarcane Industry Investment Promotion Policy. Interested investors can register their interest through the SIPP portal. Sugarcane Commissioner Anil Kumar Jha and senior officials from the department and NIC were present at the launch.

bihar_raw_news.title: Flood crisis deepens in Bihar as embankments breached by Gandak River across multiple districts
bihar_raw_news.content: Flood crisis deepens in Bihar as embankments breached by Gandak River across multiple districts Flooding in Bihar has worsened after heavy rainfall in Nepal’s Gandak basin, affecting around 2.03 lakh people across six districts. Rising river levels and multiple embankment breaches have inundated villages, disrupted roads and forced residents to seek safer locations amid rescue operations By IANS Published Date - 1 October 2026, 12:14 PM Patna: The flood situation in Bihar has worsened following heavy rainfall in Nepal’s Gandak basin, with the river swelling sharply and embankments breached at several locations. Around 2.03 lakh people across six districts are reported to have been affected, with West Champaran, Saran, Gopalganj and Muzaffarpur among the worst-hit areas. The Water Resources Department had recorded a discharge of 5.435 lakh cusecs at the Valmikinagar Gandak Barrage, with the flow remaining above 5 lakh cusecs for several hours. The surge has put further pressure on embankments and low-lying areas downstream. In Saran, the right Saran embankment of the Gandak near Haijalpur in Maker block was damaged during the intervening night of Tuesday and Wednesday. Reports also indicated damage near Baghakol, with floodwaters entering nearby low-lying areas. A house in Haijalpur village was reportedly swept away by the strong current after the embankment gave way. Floodwaters spread across several villages, forcing residents to move to embankments, rooftops and other safer locations. Water from the Gandak has also reached the NH-722 area near Maker, disrupting movement and raising concerns for villages along the affected stretch. In Gopalganj’s Baikunthpur block, the Bandhauli-Sheetalpur-Faizullahpur Zamindari Bund was breached at Sheetalpur amid intense pressure from the swollen Gandak. According to the Water Resources Department, the initial breach was around six metres wide. Floodwaters threatened low-lying areas around Parsauni, Sheetalpur and Pakhan, with the breach putting several surrounding villages at risk. The situation also deteriorated in Muzaffarpur, where an old Gandak embankment at Jaimal Dumri in Paru block was breached. Floodwaters subsequently spread towards nearby residential areas, prompting residents to move to safer and higher locations. Local reports said water entered homes and roads in the affected area, while rescue and monitoring operations were intensified by the administration. Several areas of West Champaran remain severely affected after breaches in the Gandak embankment system. Bagaha, Bairia and Yogapatti are among the areas facing inundation, with residents taking shelter on roads, embankments and at relief centres. The Gandak had earlier reached a record 91.25 metres at the Bagaha gauge, exceeding the previous high of 90.90 metres recorded in 2024. Floodwaters have also disrupted road connectivity at several locations. The Chhapra-Sattarghat route has been affected, while water has accumulated on stretches of the Areraj-Hajipur road, disrupting traffic. Movement has also been affected in West Champaran, where floodwaters have reached the Machhargawan area. The rising water level of the Ganga has added to concerns in other parts of Bihar, with the river rising in the Patna-Begusarai-Khagaria belt. bihar_raw_news.title: Supreme Court Upholds High Court Decision on Sales Tax Exemption for Industrial Units
bihar_raw_news.content: Home Judgement Scroll Down To Discover Supreme Court Supreme Court Upholds High Court Decision on Sales Tax Exemption for Industrial Units — Clarifies Applicability of Industrial Policy. Admin 2026-10-01 17:42:06 10 Share This Article: Font size: Print Case Note & Summary The case involved the State of Bihar challenging the High Court's ruling that granted sales tax exemption to certain industrial units under the Industrial Policy of 1993. The dispute arose from a notification issued by the State Government on 4th April 1994, which restricted sales tax exemptions to units that had not availed benefits under previous policies. The High Court ruled that this restriction was invalid, leading the State to appeal. The Supreme Court examined the relevant clauses of the Industrial Policy, particularly Clause 10.4(i)(b), which provided for sales tax exemptions for old industrial units that commenced production before 1.4.93 and had investments not exceeding Rs. 15 Crores. The Court found that the High Court's interpretation was correct, affirming that these units were entitled to the exemption for seven years from 1.4.93. The Court also addressed the validity of the notification under Section 7 of the Bihar Finance Act, concluding that it could not impose conditions that contradicted the benefits outlined in the Industrial Policy. Ultimately, the Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, upholding the High Court's decision and confirming the entitlement of the industrial units to the sales tax exemption. Headnote A) Administrative Law - Notification Validity - Sales Tax Exemption Notification Struck Down - Bihar Finance Act, 1981, Section 7 - The High Court found the notification restricting sales tax exemption to only those units not availing previous benefits to be contrary to the Industrial Policy of 1993. The Supreme Court upheld this finding, affirming that the notification could not negate benefits available under the policy. (Paras 4-5). B) Industrial Policy - Eligibility for Sales Tax Exemption - Old Industrial Units Entitled to Exemption - Industrial Policy, 1993, Clause 10.4(i)(b) - The Court concluded that old industrial units with investments under Rs. 15 Crores on 1.4.93 are entitled to sales tax exemption for seven years, despite starting production earlier. This interpretation aligns with the policy's intent to support industrial growth. (Paras 3-4). national_raw_news.title: 6 hours ago | National 243 Nationwide cleanliness drive being conducted as part of Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign
national_raw_news.content: The nationwide Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath cleanliness drive is being conducted as part of the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign. The objective of the campaign is to ensure cleanliness, improve sanitation and create awareness about hygiene and proper waste disposal among the general public. Several Union Ministers, Chief Minister and senior officials are participating in the cleanliness drive across the country. The Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign, which began on 17th of last month, will be observed till 17th of October. The theme of this year’s campaign is – Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat, which underlines the role of collective participation and shared responsibility in advancing the vision of a Swachh and Viksit Bharat. Union Jal Shakti Minister C R Paatil participated in a Shramdaan activity at Kalindi Kunj Ghat in New Delhi. Talking to reporters, Mr Paatil said that cleanliness and water conservation are inseparable and emphasised the need to keep rivers clean. He said that treating rivers as garbage bins and dumping waste into them will pollute the water and adversely affect human life. Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju attended the Swachhata Hi Seva programme at Peshwa Road Navyug School in the national capital. He said Prime Minister Narendra Modi has placed special emphasis on cleanliness and sanitation. Mr Rijiju said that a cleaner India will lead to a healthier India. Union Minister For Coal and Mines G. Kishan Reddy also participated in the cleanliness drive in Delhi. Speaking on the occasion, Mr Reddy said, ‘Cleanliness is not just about cleaning, but it should be a part of the behaviour. Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi also undertook the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 cleanliness drive at Gargi College in New Delhi. During the drive, he interacted with the students, including from the NSS, NCC and sports communities and appreciated their enthusiasm and active participation. Mr Joshi said that the students’ commitment to cleanliness and civic responsibility was truly encouraging. Union Minister for Civil Aviation Ram Mohan Naidu has said that cleanliness is a continuous process and should become an integral part of our daily work and thinking. Addressing a programme organised at the Ministry of Civil Aviation under the Swachhata Hi Seva campaign, Mr Naidu urged everyone to become ambassadors of cleanliness and contribute towards making India cleaner. He said the government’s aim is to make cleanliness a key pillar of the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. He added that even the smallest contribution can make a significant difference in achieving this goal. The Civil Aviation Minister said that airports across the country are also emerging as symbols of cleanliness. He noted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Swachhata mission is no longer limited to cities but is reaching the grassroots level. Mr Naidu said that everyone is committed to building a clean India.

national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that the country is moving rapidly on the Reform Express and the institutions that conduct examinations must also work on reforms that are the need of the country. Addressing the Centenary Celebrations of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi today, Mr Modi said that an examination should not be considered just an event as it is related to the future of the youth. Mr Modi noted that a delay of even a few months can create difficulties for the youth, and therefore, the examination system should follow the principle of time certainty. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that over the 100-year journey of UPSC, the generations, governments, technology, and syllabi have changed, but the trust in this institution remains as unwavering as ever. Mr Modi stressed the need to bring young people into public services who are drawn not to public office but to public service. He said, today, 21st-century India is moving forward with a new work culture and its core principle is Pro-People, Pro-Active, Good Governance. The Prime Minister said his Government’s mantra is Nagarik Devo Bhava and serving the citizens is paramount. He said, for a Viksit Bharat, the kind of governance the country now needs will be enabled to a great extent by institutions such as the UPSC and the State Public Service Commissions. Mr Modi said the young people being recruited today will play an important role in building a Viksit Bharat. Prime Minister Modi said India in 2047 will be very different from the India of today. He said India will be more urban, the gap between villages and cities will be smaller, and the aspirations and expectations of the citizens, especially the youth, will be much higher. He said the next 20 to 25 years will be extremely important for every Indian and for every institution in the country. Minister of State for Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions Dr Jitendra Singh said that UPSC has achieved several milestones and added many new dimensions during the last twelve years. He said the number of government appointments made through UPSC has increased, and transparency in the recruitment system has also improved, leading to greater public trust. Dr Singh highlighted that approximately 65 thousand appointments were made through the UPSC during the NDA’s 12-year tenure, compared with around 45 thousand appointments during the UPA’s ten-year tenure. The Minister said that today, UPSC has become a role model for recruitment agencies across the country and the world. Chairman UPSC Dr Ajay Kumar said, since independence, generations of the nation’s youth have come to the Commission’s doorstep with dreams of serving the country and UPSC has ensured that they are judged solely on the touchstone of merit. He said, currently, women constitute approximately 30 per cent of the successful candidates in the Civil Services Examination. Dr Kumar said, measures such as identifying duplicate applications with the help of Artificial Intelligence, real-time OCR-based evaluation of millions of documents uploaded by candidates and face authentication for lakhs of candidates at examination centers are some of the recent steps adopted by the Commission to further strengthen fairness and security. The programme marks the culmination of year-long celebrations that commenced on 1st October last year, commemorating 100 years since the establishment of the UPSC in 1926. On the occasion, Prime Minister Modi released a UPSC Centenary Commemorative Coin, a Commemorative Stamp and a Book titled ‘100 Landmark Judgements – Shaping the Policies of UPSC and Public Service Commissions in India ‘.

national_raw_news.title: 7 hours ago | National 126 Govt cuts sugar stock holding period of dealers to 15 days to check hoarding and other malpractices
national_raw_news.content: The Government has reduced the stock holding period for sugar dealers to 15 days and fixed the stock holding limit at one thousand quintals, with effect from the 15th of this month. It will remain effective till November this year. Consumer Affairs Ministry said that the government has revised the sugar stock holding norms to prevent hoarding and ensure smooth supply to consumers during the festive season. Under the revised provisions, the stock holding limit for Kolkata and its extended metropolitan areas and Assam have been fixed at two thousand quintals. The Ministry said, Kolkata sources sugar from Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka and supplies it to the eastern part of the country, including the North-Eastern region. The higher limit for Assam has been provided keeping in view geographical constraints, transportation logistics and consumer interest in the North-Eastern region. The Ministry said that average retail sugar prices have declined by 15 per cent from their August peak and are expected to decline further. Ex-mill sugar prices have also declined by approximately 28 per cent and have remained stable over the last three weeks. The decline reflects the impact of various measures taken by the Government to ensure adequate availability of sugar and facilitate its orderly movement through the market. Wholesalers and retailers have also been urged to immediately pass on the benefit of the substantial decline in ex-mill sugar prices to consumers.

national_raw_news.title: 7 hours ago | National 164 Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasises integrated financial systems for defence management and...
national_raw_news.content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has said that the same spirit of synergy and integration currently being emphasised among the three armed forces needs to be implemented within the financial framework of the Defence Accounts Department as well. Addressing the Defence Accounts Day in New Delhi today, he said that if the financial systems are also integrated, the entire defence management will become even more efficient. He said that this department serves as a common thread connecting the entire Ministry of Defence and is the backbone of the defence system. The Minister urged them to adopt and internalise the best practices in quality auditing at both the national and international levels and keep pace with evolving standards across the country and the world. Mr Singh stated that, during the last financial year, expenditure booking stood at approximately 100 percent. He said, this achievement marks a significant milestone and is a testament to the concerted efforts of the Defence Accounts Department and the three Services. The Minister added that this achievement reflects their unwavering commitment, dedication, hard work, and efficiency in ensuring the effective utilisation of resources. During the event, the Defence Minister launched several Information Technology initiatives of the Defence Accounts Department aimed at strengthening financial management and digital systems within the Ministry of Defence. These include the integration of the Indian Army Financial Information System with the Department’s SAKSHAM platform, the revamped National Compilation System for the Ministry of Defence, and the Payment Routing and Integrated System Management (PRISM) platform.
